description: F-HW-02 — counterbore part fixture for /occt/op/hole/counterbore wiring. Pure data: hole spec + termination + expected per-position metadata. Worker side is blocked in W3 (occt-worker task #31); this file pins the input/output shape for W4+ wiring.
notes: Worker side (/occt/op/hole/counterbore) is blocked in W3 — wire-up in W4 once occt-worker src/ exists.
The 11 mm head pocket × 6.5 mm depth defaults derive from ISO 4762 socket-cap-screw heights × 1.10 (spec §3.1 note).
headDiameter > diameter invariant: 11.0 > 6.6 — passes CBORE_SMALLER_THAN_BORE validator gate.
drillTipAngle is suppressed (180° flat) for through-all bores per spec §2.1 — the field is preserved so blind variants of the same fixture reuse the schema.
